description: Find AI tools that may connect with a given tool, based on GateOnAI's IO-Compatibility Graph - computed automatically by matching the input/output content types (text, image, audio, video, code, etc.) that GateOnAI assigns to each tool. The tags are assigned automatically and can be wrong; connections are not tested. Answers questions like 'what tools work well with ChatGPT' or 'what can I feed ChatGPT's output into'. The graph has 63,459 computed connections.

limit.description: Number of connected tools to return (default: 8, max: 20)

slug.description: URL slug of the AI tool to find connections for. Examples: 'chatgpt', 'midjourney', 'claude'

name: get_compatible_tools

is_error.description: True if the tool could not complete the request

links.description: gateonai.com URLs referenced in the result, in order of appearance

markdown.description: The full result as Markdown (same as the text content), including GateOnAI's disclaimer

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced this result

title: Get Compatible AI Tools
